speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing
text: asked the Minister for National Development whether there are measures to ensure that foreign registered cars pay their outstanding HDB and URA parking fines before entry into, or exit out of, Singapore.

speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
text: So, it gives a wrong impression that the Malaysian vehicles do not have to pay their fine and there is no enforcement.

speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
text: So, I really hope for stricter enforcement to deter these vehicles from flagrantly not paying the fines.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: And now with this rule where they can be prevented from entering Singapore, I think they will take it very seriously indeed.
